mandatory_legal_checks: Civil Procedure Code 1908 Order XXIII Rule 3 — where proceedings are pending, consider recording the settlement as a CONSENT DECREE; a decree is executable, a bare agreement must be sued on afresh
Contract Act 1872 S.63 — remission; the release must be conditional on actual payment or the releasing party gives up its claims for nothing
Contract Act 1872 S.23 — a release cannot waive a right the law does not permit to be waived
Income-tax Act 1961 — deduction at source depends on the CHARACTER of the payment, not on the label 'settlement'; determine it before paying
Indian Stamp Act 1899 — a settlement may attract duty; confirm the State position
Do not apply to dispose of the proceedings before payment is received in full
